title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?
items.abstract_or_text: Does structured mathematical knowledge help LLMs prove theorems in Lean 4? If so, for which models, and does the answer vary by problem? Formal libraries such as Mathlib encode 285,000+ verified theorems with syntactic dependencies, but the semantic layer mathematicians rely on for discovery (analogies, generalizations, cross-domain bridges) remains implicit. We introduce MathAgent, which builds this layer as a knowledge graph, MathKG, and uses it to augment LLM theorem provers. MathKG connects 364 Mathlib theorems and definitions by 9,434 typed semantic edges inferred via LLM-based relation extraction anchored to verified Mathlib declarations. We run a controlled ablation across four augmentation modes (no context, knowledge-graph context, Mathlib retrieval, both) and five models: Qwen3-8B/32B, their Lean-specialized derivatives Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, on miniF2F, plus PutnamBench and MathOlympiadBench for Sonnet. Three findings emerge. (i) Specialization dominates augmentation: Lean fine-tuning adds 33-38 percentage points of solve rate in every mode, and a specialized 8B model beats a 4\times larger general one by 29-35 points, while no augmentation mode improves solve rate by more than 3 points. (ii) Augmentation is capability-conditioned: knowledge-graph context helps small models but hurts large ones, with the specialized model gaining more relative to its general base at every scale. (iii) Yet the augmentation modes solve different problems: an oracle selecting the best mode per problem solves 6% to 58% more than the unaugmented prover, a complementarity effect that strengthens on harder problems (32% more on PutnamBench). These results motivate adaptive strategies that select augmentation by model capability and problem. Code, data, and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent
items.summary_zh: MathAgent 用 MathKG 将 Mathlib 定理和定义的语义关系显式化，并在 Lean 4 定理证明中进行受控消融。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时比较通用模型、Lean 专用模型和多种知识增强方式，报告了可复现实验差异，显示专门化的收益大于单纯增加检索上下文。
items.abstract_zh: 结构化数学知识是否能帮助 LLM 在 Lean 4 中证明定理？如果能帮助，适用于哪些模型，这一答案是否因问题而异？Mathlib 等形式化库编码了 285,000 多个带有句法依赖关系的已验证定理，但数学家用于发现的语义层（类比、推广、跨领域桥接）仍是隐式的。我们提出 MathAgent：它构建这一层语义知识图谱 MathKG，并用其增强 LLM 定理证明器。MathKG 将 364 个 Mathlib 定理和定义连接起来，包含 9,434 条有类型的语义边；这些边通过基于 LLM 的关系抽取推断得到，并锚定在已验证的 Mathlib 声明上。我们在 miniF2F 上对四种增强模式（无上下文、知识图谱上下文、Mathlib 检索、二者结合）和五个模型进行受控消融：Qwen3-8B/32B、其 Lean 专用衍生模型 Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B，以及 Claude Sonnet 4.6；对 Sonnet 还使用了 PutnamBench 和 MathOlympiadBench。研究得到三项发现。(i) 专门化胜过增强：在每种模式下，Lean 微调都使求解率提高 33–38 个百分点；专用的 8B 模型比大 4 倍的通用模型高 29–35 个百分点，而任何增强模式带来的求解率提升都不超过 3 个百分点。(ii) 增强效果取决于能力：知识图谱上下文能帮助小模型，却会损害大模型；在每个规模上，专用模型相对于其通用基座模型的相对增益都更大。(iii) 不过，各增强模式解决的问题并不相同：如果由一个 oracle 为每道题选择最佳模式，求解数比未增强证明器多 6% 至 58%；这种互补效应在更难的问题上更强（在 PutnamBench 上多 32%）。这些结果支持根据模型能力和问题选择增强方式的自适应策略。代码、数据和产物见 https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent
items.author_line: Sareh Nabi, Roland Vogl, Marzieh Nabi

items.title: An RL View of OPD: Least Square Policy Distillation for Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) through the lens of reinforcement learning, establishing a connection between the reverse-KL objective in OPD and KL-regularized policy optimization. Building on this connection, we introduce Least-Square Policy Distillation (LSPD), an RL-inspired framework that brings optimistic exploration and off-policy data reuse from value-based RL into policy distillation. LSPD preserves policy diversity through exploration while improving rollout efficiency by repeatedly learning from previously collected trajectories. Our theoretical analysis connects LSPD to optimistic value-based learning and shows that its idealized formulation achieves a sharp \mathcal O(\log K) regret bound under online exploration. Empirically, LSPD consistently outperforms existing distillation baselines across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and diverse teacher-student settings, with average gains of +1.59 points in Avg@16. Remarkably, through Pass@k evaluations up to k=64, we found that LSPD better preserves policy diversity by achieving stronger performance as k grows. Its fully off-policy variant achieves comparable performance to vanilla OPD using only the first 25% of rollout batches. Together, these results provide an RL perspective on OPD that offers both a principled interpretation and a practical route toward more effective and rollout-efficient language model distillation.
items.summary_zh: LSPD 从强化学习角度重释 on-policy distillation，并以乐观探索和离策略数据复用提高数学推理蒸馏的样本效率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文同时给出 O(log K) 遗憾界和六个数学推理基准上的实证结果，连接了理论保证、Pass@k 多样性与 rollout 成本。
items.abstract_zh: 我们从强化学习的角度研究 on-policy distillation（OPD），建立 OPD 中的 reverse-KL 目标与 KL 正则化策略优化之间的联系。在此基础上，我们提出 Least-Square Policy Distillation（LSPD），这是一个受强化学习启发的框架，将基于价值的强化学习中的乐观探索和离策略数据复用引入策略蒸馏。LSPD 通过探索保持策略多样性，同时通过反复利用先前收集的轨迹进行学习来提高 rollout 效率。我们的理论分析将 LSPD 与乐观的基于价值的学习联系起来，并表明其理想化形式在在线探索下达到尖锐的 O(log K) 遗憾界。在实证方面，在六个数学推理基准和多种教师—学生设置中，LSPD 始终优于现有蒸馏基线，Avg@16 平均提升 +1.59 分。值得注意的是，通过最高 k=64 的 Pass@k 评估，我们发现 LSPD 能更好地保持策略多样性，因为随着 k 增大其性能提升更强。其完全离策略变体只使用前 25% 的 rollout 批次，就达到了与 vanilla OPD 相当的性能。总体而言，这些结果从强化学习视角为 OPD 提供了原理性解释，并为更有效、节省 rollout 的语言模型蒸馏提供了实践路径。
items.author_line: Shangzhe Li, Yuxiao Yang, Tianrun Yu, Kaixiang Zhao, Xiaoyun Wang, Taylor W. Killian, Weitong Zhang

items.title: ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Formalizing research-level stochastic optimization in Lean requires both an algorithm model and domain theory connecting foundational libraries to convergence proofs. Revising a model to restore provability can change the mathematical claim. We introduce ProofLoom, a fully automated LLM-agent system for Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction. Given a published algorithm, target theorem, and source proof, ProofLoom autonomously constructs the Lean model and supporting theory. Open proof obligations drive the development of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans. Signature contracts record evidence and obligations for model revisions; an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims, and Audit checks whether the Lean proof follows it. Across tasks, SOptLib accumulates verified mathematics and construction experience: reusable results are extracted, generalized, and verified, while modeling decisions and failed proof routes are recorded. Later tasks retrieve these results and records and contribute new developments, forming a cycle of construction, accumulation, and reuse. On fifteen textbook and research-paper tasks, ProofLoom obtains mean human ratings of 6.3/7 and 6.4/7, compared with 4.9/7 and 5.0/7 for the strongest of six baselines. Across 33 developments, it produces 490,693 lines of algorithm-local Lean code with no sorry. The formalizations also expose 28 incorrect formulas, proof gaps, and algorithm-analysis mismatches in published sources across 22 developments, each with checked evidence.
items.summary_zh: ProofLoom 以证明义务驱动的方式自动构建研究级随机优化的 Lean 理论，并用独立审查约束模型假设和结论。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 33 项开发中生成无 sorry 的 Lean 代码，并对公开来源发现可检查的公式错误、证明缺口和算法分析不一致，直接体现证明助手的核验价值。
items.abstract_zh: 在 Lean 中形式化研究级随机优化，需要同时具备算法模型，以及把基础库连接到收敛性证明的领域理论。修改模型以恢复可证性，可能会改变数学主张。我们提出 ProofLoom，一个完全自动化的 LLM agent 系统，用于证明义务驱动的理论构建。给定一个已发表的算法、目标定理和源证明，ProofLoom 会自主构建 Lean 模型及其支撑理论。未完成的证明义务驱动定义、接口、引理和证明计划的开发。签名契约记录模型修改的证据和义务；独立的 Judge 会拒绝没有支持的假设和被削弱的结论。Planner 将已发表的论证扩展为中间主张，Audit 则检查 Lean 证明是否遵循该论证。在多个任务中，SOptLib 积累经过验证的数学和构建经验：它提取、推广并验证可复用结果，同时记录建模决策和失败的证明路径。后续任务检索这些结果和记录，并贡献新的发展，形成构建、积累和复用的循环。在 15 个教材和研究论文任务上，ProofLoom 获得的人类平均评分分别为 6.3/7 和 6.4/7，而六个基线中最强者分别为 4.9/7 和 5.0/7。在 33 项开发中，它生成了 490,693 行算法局部 Lean 代码，且没有使用 sorry。这些形式化还在 22 项开发中发现了已发表来源中的 28 个错误公式、证明缺口和算法—分析不一致，每一项都有经过检查的证据。
items.author_line: Feiming Wang, Daibo Li, Kun Yuan

items.title: TCSAlgBench: Benchmarking Automated Proving for Research-Level Theoretical Computer Science
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.
items.summary_zh: TCSAlgBench 从 STOC 和 COLT 论文中构建可刷新、定理级的理论计算机科学自动证明基准，并比较模型和 agent 工作流。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务保留计算假设与定量保证，使用 verifier-accepted coverage 作为可检查指标，能更接近研究级证明发现而非竞赛题拟合。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在竞赛数学上表现很强，但其研究级推理仍难以系统评估。理论计算机科学（TCS）把算法设计与明确保证及基本极限联系起来，为评估模型能否用人类可检查的论证证明计算改进提供了一个场景。我们提出 TCSAlgBench，一个用于自然语言证明发现的基准和可复用流水线，其中包含来自 138 篇 STOC 和 COLT 2026 论文的 398 个定理级挑战。专家设计的规则补充论文特定上下文，保留计算假设和定量保证；当任务要求发现算法时，则隐藏构造。对于每项任务，证明器系统接收定理陈述，并可访问所引用的先前工作。该流水线支持根据新发布论文生成全新的、有版本标识的挑战批次。我们在直接推理和 prover-verifier 讨论两种设置下，评估来自四个家族的十种模型配置，并在匹配模型调用机会的条件下比较四种 agent 工作流。所有评估都使用完整基准。在模型比较中，GPT-5.6 Sol max 在 10 轮讨论后取得最高的五次运行 verifier-accepted coverage，为 23.6%。讨论和重复采样都会提高覆盖率。在独立的 agent 比较中，使用 GPT-5.5 xhigh，分解相较于讨论提高了覆盖率，而 agentic planning 取得最高的五次运行 verifier-accepted coverage，为 25.4%。TCSAlgBench 提供了一个可刷新测试台，用于测量模型推理进展，并研究 agent 工作流如何支持研究级证明发现。
items.author_line: Chutong Yang, Xiyuan Zhang, Yu Huang, Boran Han, Soonho Kong, Shuai Zhang, Vihang Prakash Patil, Zhen Han, Michael Bohlke-Schneider, Bernie Wang

items.title: Zero-Storage Procedural Neural Synthesis via Boundary Dynamics: Formal Verification in Lean 4 and Bare-Metal Gauntlet Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Contemporary neural inference architectures rely on dense floating-point weight matrices stored in high-bandwidth memory (VRAM), incurring severe memory-wall bottlenecks and preventing native execution inside deterministic virtual machines like the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Verifying termination and arithmetic invariants for recursive dynamical systems over continuous domains is generally undecidable in the Blum-Shub-Smale model. Here, we present the formal verification and bare-metal empirical validation of WERR (Waves & Errors) and Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), a non-tensor decision paradigm that procedurally synthesizes non-linear decision boundaries on demand from a 24-byte coordinate seed Θ= (c_x, c_y, zoom) along the boundary of the Mandelbrot set (\partialM). By projecting the recurrence z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c onto the modular residue ring Z/9Z and the fixed-point domain Q_{16.16}, we establish ten machine-verified theorems in Lean 4 (v4.34.1) with Mathlib4 and zero unproven conjectures (sorry): proving I_3 = \{0,3,6\} \subset Z/9Z ideal closure, universal fuel-bounded halting (\le 9 and \le 12 steps), absence of Q_{16.16} square overflow below 2^{63}-1, non-constant boundary escape sensitivity, and a parametric EVM gas bound (\le 22,557 \le 24,000 gas). Evaluated on a 40-core Dual Intel Xeon server, the vectorized 36-iteration CPU kernel processes 100,000 decisions in 6.49 s (15,397 decisions/s, 0 Bytes VRAM, 15.15x speedup), while a sigmoidal outlier gate suppresses 100.00% of adversarial spikes while preserving 89.60% of clean baseline signals.
items.summary_zh: 该工作在 Lean 4/Mathlib4 中形式验证 WERR 与 Phase III OED 的算术不变量、终止性和 EVM gas 上界，并进行裸机性能验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 摘要明确列出十个无 sorry 的机器核验定理及其边界条件，同时报告吞吐、显存和对抗尖峰抑制结果，便于复核形式化与实测两部分。
items.abstract_zh: 当代神经推理架构依赖存储在高带宽内存（VRAM）中的稠密浮点权重矩阵，从而产生严重的内存墙瓶颈，并阻碍其在以太坊虚拟机（EVM）等确定性虚拟机中原生执行。在 Blum-Shub-Smale 模型中，验证连续域上递归动力系统的终止性和算术不变量通常是不可判定的。这里我们展示 WERR（Waves & Errors）和 Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics（OED）的形式验证与裸机实证验证。这是一种非张量决策范式，可根据 Mandelbrot 集边界 ∂M 上的 24 字节坐标种子 Θ=(c_x,c_y,zoom) 按需程序化合成非线性决策边界。我们把递推 z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c 投影到模剩余环 Z/9Z 和定点域 Q_{16.16} 上，使用 Lean 4（v4.34.1）与 Mathlib4 建立了十个机器验证定理，并且没有未证明的猜想（sorry）：证明 I_3={0,3,6} 是 Z/9Z 的理想闭包、通用的燃料有界停机（≤9 步和 ≤12 步）、在 2^63−1 以下不存在 Q_{16.16} 平方溢出、边界逃逸敏感性不是常数，以及参数化 EVM gas 上界（≤22,557≤24,000 gas）。在一台 40 核 Dual Intel Xeon 服务器上评估时，向量化的 36 次迭代 CPU 内核在 6.49 秒内处理 100,000 次决策（15,397 次决策/秒、0 Bytes VRAM、15.15 倍加速）；同时，sigmoidal outlier gate 抑制了 100.00% 的对抗尖峰，并保留 89.60% 的干净基线信号。
items.author_line: Volkan Dağlı, Zerrin Dağlı, Dağhan Dağlı

items.title: Verifying Neural Networks with Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Formal verification can play a key role in ensuring the reliability of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) deployed in safety-critical systems. Modern DNN verifiers employ a branch-and-bound framework, which alternates between branching (splitting into smaller subproblems) and bounding (pruning subproblems) to efficiently explore the verification space. However, existing branching heuristics make greedy decisions based on static scoring functions. They do not anticipate long-term efficiency or leverage the growing availability of verification data to improve performance. This work introduces RSB, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to refine baseline branching heuristics. It trains an actor-critic architecture to maximize cumulative future rewards rather than immediate scores. The actor generates attention weights from observations of raw neuron features and learned graph embeddings, which rescale baseline heuristic scores to guide neuron branching. Evaluation on 600 challenging instances demonstrates that RSB consistently outperforms state-of-the-art branching heuristics, solving 11% more instances while reducing branch exploration by 50%.
items.summary_zh: RSB 用 actor-critic 强化学习改进神经网络验证器的 branch-and-bound 分支启发式，在神经元特征和图嵌入上学习长期收益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 600 个困难实例上同时报告求解数量和分支探索量，结果直接对应形式验证效率，而非只比较生成文本质量。
items.abstract_zh: 形式验证可以在确保部署于安全关键系统的深度神经网络（DNN）可靠性方面发挥关键作用。现代 DNN 验证器采用 branch-and-bound 框架，在分支（把问题拆分为更小的子问题）和界定（剪枝子问题）之间交替，以高效探索验证空间。然而，现有分支启发式依据静态评分函数做出贪心决策，既不预见长期效率，也没有利用不断增加的验证数据来改进性能。本文提出 RSB，一个用于改进基线分支启发式的强化学习框架。它训练 actor-critic 架构来最大化未来累积奖励，而不是即时分数。actor 从原始神经元特征和学习到的图嵌入中生成注意力权重，对基线启发式分数进行重新缩放，以引导神经元分支。在 600 个具有挑战性的实例上的评估表明，RSB 始终优于最先进的分支启发式：多求解 11% 的实例，同时将分支探索量减少 50%。
items.author_line: Hai Duong, Thanh Le, ThanhVu Nguyen

items.title: Validating Memory-Optimal Transformer Kernels on Real Hardware: From Formal Derivation to Measured Performance Across Two HPC Clusters
items.abstract_or_text: We validate memory-optimal cost functions for transformer kernels derived via the Mathematics of Arrays (MoA). Companion Papers I-IV formally derive kernels for attention forward, backward, fused forward+backward, decode, and the complete block (RMSNorm, gated MLP) as a hardware-independent specification (DNF) transformed to a machine-specific realization (ONF) via gamma, with verification to machine precision against PyTorch. This paper checks those predictions against measured performance on two HPC clusters (Purdue Anvil, NCSA Delta) across CPU and GPU. Three results stand out. (1) We identify and fix a GPU regression: fusing forward+backward, proven to avoid materializing an O(n^2) intermediate, initially ran slower than naive on GPU due to atomic contention. Profiling confirmed 2.00x more atomic instructions; a targeted ONF rewrite reversed it, yielding up to 2.5x speedup. (2) Identical derivations produce markedly different real costs by topology: 535x NUMA-locality penalty on one cluster vs <3x oversubscription on another, showing optimal deployment is a function of the machine's array structure. (3) We report a partially resolved anomaly: identical denotational computations run faster in C than Fortran on CPU but faster in Fortran than C on GPU, narrowed to one dominant kernel and one memory-latency stall mechanism (3.17x time gap matches 3.35x stall gap). We treat hardware-specific optimization as a routine ONF rewrite with fixed, verified DNF, a candidate methodology for scaling AI onto evolving hardware without re-deriving correctness.
items.summary_zh: 论文把 Mathematics of Arrays 推导出的 Transformer 内存最优成本函数与两座 HPC 集群的 CPU/GPU 实测连接起来，并分析形式推导到机器实现的偏差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 除机器精度验证外，还定位 GPU 原子竞争回归并修复，展示形式化成本模型如何指导可复核的硬件优化。
items.abstract_zh: 我们验证通过 Mathematics of Arrays（MoA）推导出的 Transformer 内核内存最优成本函数。配套的论文 I–IV 将 attention forward、backward、fused forward+backward、decode 以及完整模块（RMSNorm、gated MLP）形式化推导为与硬件无关的规范（DNF），再通过 gamma 转换为特定机器的实现（ONF），并与 PyTorch 进行机器精度级验证。本文在两个 HPC 集群（Purdue Anvil、NCSA Delta）的 CPU 和 GPU 上，通过测量性能检查这些预测。三个结果尤为突出。(1) 我们发现并修复了一个 GPU 回归：已证明能避免物化 O(n^2) 中间结果的 fused forward+backward，在 GPU 上最初却因原子竞争而慢于朴素实现。性能分析确认原子指令多出 2.00 倍；有针对性的 ONF 重写扭转了这一结果，最高带来 2.5 倍加速。(2) 相同推导在不同拓扑上产生显著不同的真实成本：一个集群出现 535 倍的 NUMA 局部性惩罚，而另一个集群的过量订阅低于 3 倍，说明最优部署取决于机器的数组结构。(3) 我们报告了一个部分解决的异常：相同的指称计算在 CPU 上 C 比 Fortran 更快，但在 GPU 上 Fortran 比 C 更快；该异常已缩小到一个主导内核和一种内存延迟停顿机制（3.17 倍的时间差与 3.35 倍的停顿差相匹配）。我们把硬件特定优化视为一种常规 ONF 重写：固定且已验证的 DNF 不变；这是一种候选方法，可在不断变化的硬件上扩展 AI，而无需重新推导正确性。

items.title: RGDT-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning for Rule-Governed Decisions and Their Justifications
items.abstract_or_text: We study reasoning in Rule-Governed Decision Tasks (RGDTs), where models apply external rules to case facts and justify decisions, as required in policy, contract, and compliance settings. Beyond the deductive capability emphasized by standard mathematical and logical reasoning tasks, RGDTs require interpreting rules and their applicability, assessing conditions from evidence, combining judgments under rules and exceptions, and providing checkable justifications. These demands motivate a benchmark assessing both decisions and their stated grounds. We introduce RGDT-Bench, providing 202.1K condition-level supervision slots across four task tracks and eight supported task-probe combinations that vary access to supporting information. Label-blind extraction and deterministic checks produce labels for warrant completeness: source-referenced coverage and consistency of stated decision grounds. The benchmark attributes failures to four process layers: rule use, condition, evidence, and aggregation, and checks the final outcome. Among evaluable correct responses, warrant incompleteness averages 40.2% across six evaluated LLMs and supported task-probe combinations. Such warrant incompleteness poses potential safety risks and remains difficult to detect: the best of seventeen existing evaluators reaches only 57.69% (random: 50%) task-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). To address this difficulty, we train a simple reward model with warrant supervision. It achieves 69.24% task-averaged AUROC among correct answers, exceeding the matched outcome-supervised baseline by 10.37 pp (percentage points) and the best existing evaluator by 11.55 pp. Beyond completeness assessment, the model outperforms both outcome-supervised baselines across nearly all response-selection comparisons, supporting RGDT-Bench's warrant supervision for RGDT reasoning.
items.summary_zh: RGDT-Bench 评估模型依据外部规则和证据作出决定并给出可核查理由，分解规则、条件、证据和聚合四层失误。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“答案正确”与“理由完整”分开，用确定性检查和 AUROC 衡量理由可靠性，揭示了仅看最终结论的评测盲点。
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究规则治理决策任务（Rule-Governed Decision Tasks，RGDTs）中的推理：模型需要将外部规则应用于案件事实并为决定提供理由，这正是政策、合同和合规场景所要求的。除了标准数学和逻辑推理任务强调的演绎能力外，RGDT 还要求解释规则及其适用性、依据证据评估条件、在规则和例外下组合判断，并提供可检查的理由。这些要求促成了一个同时评估决定和所述依据的基准。我们提出 RGDT-Bench，在四个任务轨道和八种支持的任务—探针组合中提供 202,100 个条件级监督槽位；这些组合改变了对支持信息的访问方式。无标签抽取和确定性检查会为理由完整性生成标签：对来源有引用的覆盖率，以及所述决定依据的一致性。该基准将失败归因于四个过程层：规则使用、条件、证据和聚合，并检查最终结果。在可评估的正确回答中，六个被评估 LLM 及支持的任务—探针组合的理由不完整率平均为 40.2%。这种理由不完整可能带来安全风险，而且很难检测：17 个现有评估器中最好的一个，在正确回答上的任务平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）只有 57.69%（随机为 50%）。为应对这一困难，我们用理由监督训练了一个简单的奖励模型。在正确回答上，它达到 69.24% 的任务平均 AUROC，比匹配的结果监督基线高 10.37 个百分点，也比最佳现有评估器高 11.55 个百分点。除完整性评估外，在几乎所有回答选择比较中，该模型都优于两个结果监督基线，支持在 RGDT 推理中使用 RGDT-Bench 的理由监督。
items.author_line: Jianpeng Zhao, Haihua Xu, Haoyang Zhang, Shuang Qian, Yixiang Tang, Xintao Wang, Kun Sun, Pei Wu, Shuhan Zhong, Pengyang Wang

items.title: BEHAVE: Functional Behavior Modeling Enables Self-Improving Agents for Hardware Design and Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Developing agents for hardware design and verification requires reliable correctness feedback. As a hardware specification may permit correct implementations with different latencies, matching design and reference outputs cycle by cycle can reject valid designs. To address this, we introduce BEHAVE, an agentic framework for multi-turn joint hardware design and verification through functional behavior modeling. We define Behavior IR to express task functionality as executable behavior models without prescribing implementation timing beyond the specification. The agent iteratively develops a register-transfer-level (RTL) design and a behavior model as the design's verification reference. Our evaluator, BEHAVE-Sim, checks both artifacts separately against a hidden golden behavior model using input stimuli generated by random sampling and solver-guided search. BEHAVE thus supports power, performance, and area (PPA) exploration across task-permitted latencies and microarchitectures. During training, the same evaluator provides verifiable reinforcement learning (RL) rewards from specification-behavior pairs without reference RTL. For self-improvement, the agent continually searches for high-level implementations relevant to its capability gaps, constructs and checks specification-behavior pairs, and trains on the expanded task pool. We release BEHAVE-Train and BEHAVE-Eval with 600 human-reviewed specification-behavior pairs for realistic hardware workloads. Starting from 60 seed tasks and acquiring 100 new tasks, self-improvement raises Qwen3.8-27B's RTL pass@1 on BEHAVE-Eval from 55.0% to 75.0%, reaching performance comparable to RL using a 540-task pool.
items.summary_zh: BEHAVE 用可执行的 Behavior IR 表示硬件功能，在隐藏 golden behavior model 下分别验证 RTL 与行为模型，并支持可验证强化学习。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务允许不同延迟和微架构，避免逐周期匹配误拒绝正确设计；自改进实验把 Qwen3.8-27B 的 RTL pass@1 从 55.0% 提升到 75.0%。
items.abstract_zh: 开发硬件设计与验证 agent 需要可靠的正确性反馈。由于硬件规范可能允许具有不同延迟的正确实现，逐周期匹配设计输出和参考输出可能会拒绝有效设计。为此，我们提出 BEHAVE：一个通过功能行为建模进行多轮联合硬件设计与验证的 agent 框架。我们定义 Behavior IR，用可执行的行为模型表达任务功能，而不对规范允许的实现时序作额外规定。该 agent 迭代开发寄存器传输级（RTL）设计和行为模型，并将后者作为设计的验证参考。我们的评估器 BEHAVE-Sim 在由随机采样和求解器引导搜索生成的输入激励下，分别将这两个产物与隐藏的 golden behavior model 进行检查。因此，BEHAVE 支持在任务允许的延迟和微架构范围内探索功耗、性能和面积（PPA）。在训练期间，同一个评估器无需参考 RTL，即可从规范—行为对中提供可验证的强化学习（RL）奖励。为实现自我改进，该 agent 持续搜索与自身能力缺口相关的高层实现，构造并检查规范—行为对，并在扩展后的任务池上训练。我们发布 BEHAVE-Train 和 BEHAVE-Eval，其中包含 600 个经人工审阅、面向真实硬件工作负载的规范—行为对。从 60 个种子任务出发并获得 100 个新任务后，自我改进使 Qwen3.8-27B 在 BEHAVE-Eval 上的 RTL pass@1 从 55.0% 提升到 75.0%，达到与使用 540 个任务的 RL 相当的性能。
items.author_line: Yuheng Wu, Berk Gokmen, Sujeeth Jinesh, Lauren McLane, Aarav Wattal, Qi Yang Huang, Zhaozhuo Xu, Thierry Tambe

items.title: Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, so fresh puzzles of controllable complexity can be generated on demand, each with a witness that guarantees solvability. We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget. Small puzzles already challenge open-weight models, whereas even proprietary models solve only about half of the large ones. Codoku thus offers a renewable testbed for program reasoning that can keep pace with rapidly improving coding agents. GitHub: https://github.com/connglli/Codoku.
items.summary_zh: Codoku 通过不可直接执行的部分程序、稀疏合法填法和可再生谜题，测试 coding agent 的程序行为推理而非运行程序取巧。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 谜题由语义重化从头合成并带有可解见证，评测在固定工具预算下覆盖 300 题，能持续更新并缓解基准污染。
items.abstract_zh: 现有程序推理基准要求大型语言模型预测程序在给定输入上的行为。Coding agent 打破了这些基准所依赖的两个假设：agent 可以执行程序而不是对其进行推理来获得答案；此外，从现有程序中抽取的固定任务集越来越容易受到污染，却很难更新。我们提出 Codoku（code sudoku），一种可再生基准：求解器要在部分程序中填入带类型的单元格，以满足全局静态和动态约束，例如规定的控制流图和执行路径。由于部分程序无法执行，而且在由相互依赖选择构成的指数级大空间中，有效填法很稀疏，因此工具使用和枚举都不能替代程序推理。谜题通过语义重化从头合成，因此可以按需生成复杂度可控的新谜题；每道题都带有保证可解性的见证。我们让五个前沿模型在 300 道谜题上接受评估，coding agent 可以在固定预算内自由使用任何工具。小型谜题已经对开放权重模型构成挑战，而即使是专有模型，在大型谜题上也只能解决约一半。Codoku 因此提供了一个可再生的程序推理测试台，能够跟上 coding agent 的快速改进。GitHub：https://github.com/connglli/Codoku。
items.author_line: Cong Li, Hao Sun, Zenan Li, Zhendong Su
